example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মটকা খালি, কোনো কাজের বুদ্ধি নেই।

example_sentences_in_english: He is empty-headed, with no practical intelligence.
Talking to this empty-headed person is a waste of time.
note: Refers to the traditional use of earthen pots in Bengali households, implying a mind as empty as an unused pot.
